note: Capture is realized flip-exit return / max MFE. Trades whose max MFE is below 0.10 ATR are reported separately rather than divided through -- the ratio is meaningless there.

expectancy.note: Denominator for the headline is ALL entries, including those stopped before confirmation -- the only figure comparable to the strategy's real expectancy. A better runner exit can only reach the flip_exit_share_of_entries fraction of the book.
